
take a look at the implementation of mandate Creation, its Service, XML generator and everything.

i want to do the same thing for pain 013

This is a structure of how it looks like.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ns2:Document
xmlns:ns2="urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.013.001.11">
<CdtrPmtActvtnReq>
<GrpHdr>
<!-- Unique message reference as generated by sending party. -->
<MsgId>{Properly Formatted String}</MsgId>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<!-- Document creation local date-time -->
<CreDtTm>{DateTime in ISO-8601 format}</CreDtTm>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<!-- Initiating party (creditor or creditor's bank) -->
<InitgPty>
<!-- Name of initiating party -->
<Nm>{InitiatingPartyName}</Nm>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<!-- Identification of initiating party -->
<Id>
<OrgId>
<Othr>
<!-- Client or organization identifier -->
<Id>{ClientId}</Id>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
</Othr>
</OrgId>
</Id>
</InitgPty>
</GrpHdr>
<PmtInf>
<!-- Payment information identification -->
<PmtInfId>{PaymentInformationId}</PmtInfId>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<!-- Payment method: TRF (Transfer) -->
<PmtMtd>TRF</PmtMtd>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<!-- Requested execution date and time -->
<ReqdExctnDt>
<DtTm>{DateTime in ISO-8601 format}</DtTm>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
</ReqdExctnDt>
<!-- Debtor (payer) information -->
<Dbtr>
<!-- Debtor name -->
<Nm>{DebtorName}</Nm>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
</Dbtr>
<DbtrAcct>
<Id>
<!-- Debtor account number -->
<IBAN>{DebtorAccountNumber}</IBAN>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<!-- Other identification (if applicable) -->
<Othr>
<Id>{OtherAccountId}</Id>
<!-- Optional Field -->
</Othr>
</Id>
<!-- Account currency -->
<Ccy>{CurrencyCode}</Ccy>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<!-- Name on debtor account -->
<Nm>{Name on Debtor Account}</Nm>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
</DbtrAcct>
<!-- Debtor agent (debtor's bank) -->
<DbtrAgt>
<FinInstnId>
<!-- Debtor agent BICFI -->
<BICFI>{DebtorAgentBIC}</BICFI>
<!-- Optional Field -->
<ClrSysMmbId>
<!-- Debtor agent member ID -->
<MmbId>{DebtorAgentMemberId}</MmbId>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
</ClrSysMmbId>
</FinInstnId>
</DbtrAgt>
<!-- Credit transfer transaction details -->
<CdtTrfTx>
<PmtId>
<!-- End-to-End reference for the transaction -->
<EndToEndId>{EndToEndId}</EndToEndId>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
</PmtId>
<Amt>
<!-- Instructed amount and currency -->
<InstdAmt Ccy="NGN">{Amount in 2dp}</InstdAmt>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
</Amt>
<!-- Creditor agent (creditor's bank) -->
<CdtrAgt>
<FinInstnId>
<!-- Creditor agent BICFI -->
<BICFI>{CreditorAgentBIC}</BICFI>
<!-- Optional Field -->
<ClrSysMmbId>
<!-- Creditor agent member ID -->
<MmbId>{CreditorAgentMemberId}</MmbId>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
</ClrSysMmbId>
</FinInstnId>
</CdtrAgt>
<!-- Creditor (beneficiary) information -->
<Cdtr>
<!-- Creditor name -->
<Nm>{CreditorName}</Nm>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
</Cdtr>
<CdtrAcct>
<Id>
<!-- Creditor account number -->
<IBAN>{CreditorAccountNumber}</IBAN>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<!-- Other identification (if applicable) -->
<Othr>
<Id>{OtherCreditorAccountId}</Id>
<!-- Optional Field -->
</Othr>
</Id>
<!-- Name on creditor account -->
<Nm>{Name on Creditor Account}</Nm>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
</CdtrAcct>
<!-- Purpose of the payment -->
<Purp>
<!-- Proprietary purpose description -->
<Prtry>{PaymentPurpose}</Prtry>
<!-- Optional Field -->
</Purp>
</CdtTrfTx>
</PmtInf>
<!-- Supplementary Data details -->
<SplmtryData>
<PlcAndNm>AdditionalVerificationDetails</PlcAndNm>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<Envlp>
<CustomData>
<DebtorInfo>
<!-- Indicates if account is individual, corporate etc. -->
<AccountDesignation>{AccountDesignation}</AccountDesignation>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<!-- Identification type: BVN, NIN, etc. -->
<IdType>{IdType}</IdType>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<!-- Identification value -->
<IdValue>{IdValue}</IdValue>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<!-- Account tier level -->
<AccountTier>{AccountTier}</AccountTier>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
</DebtorInfo>
<DebtorMetadata>
<!-- Biometric data if applicable -->
<BiometricData>{BiometricData}</BiometricData>
<!-- Optional Field -->
<!-- Address line -->
<AdrLine>{AddressLine}</AdrLine>
<!-- Optional Field -->
<!-- Phone number -->
<PhneNb>{PhoneNumber}</PhneNb>
<!-- Optional Field -->
<!-- Email address -->
<EmailAdr>{EmailAddress}</EmailAdr>
<!-- Optional Field -->
</DebtorMetadata>
<CreditorInfo>
<AccountDesignation>{AccountDesignation}</AccountDesignation>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<IdType>{IdType}</IdType>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<IdValue>{IdValue}</IdValue>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<AccountTier>{AccountTier}</AccountTier>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
</CreditorInfo>
<TransactionInfo>
<!-- Transaction location coordinates -->
<TransactionLocation>{TransactionLocation}</TransactionLocation>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<!-- Channel code: 1-Branch, 2-Internet Banking, 3-Mobile Phones, 4-POS Terminals, etc. -->
<ChannelCode>{ChannelCode}</ChannelCode>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
<!-- Mandate category -->
<MandateCategory>{MandateCategory}</MandateCategory>
<!-- Mandatory Field -->
</TransactionInfo>
</CustomData>
</Envlp>
</SplmtryData>
</CdtrPmtActvtnReq>
</ns2:Document>
